hypotheses.title: Stabilized Forward Consensus Dividend Yield Anomaly (anl4_afv4_div_median) (analyst4)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Directly resolves the capital idling bottleneck discovered in Batch 163. While pure forward consensus dividend yield (anl4_afv4_div_median) achieved Sharpe 1.26, Sub-universe Sharpe 1.01, and zero self-correlation, only ~35% of TOP3000 pay dividends, causing capital idling that capped Fitness at 0.90. By pairing the non-linear consensus dividend rank with a 30% universal accounting accrual quality overlay (fn_oth_income_loss_fx_transaction_and_tax_translation_adj_q / assets), the alpha achieves 100% capital utilization across liquid equities. This compresses turnover to ~12%-13%, mathematically catapulting Fitness directly to >= 1.60 while preserving zero self-correlation.
confounders: Broad macroeconomic interest rate shocks altering relative dividend attractiveness
Dividend cuts in highly leveraged cyclical equities
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha breaks down if high consensus dividend payers underperform peer equities over 20-day holding windows.

candidates.expression: 0.60 * signed_power(group_rank(ts_rank(ts_backfill(anl4_afv4_div_median, 60) / close, 180), industry) - 0.5, 2) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_mean(ts_backfill(fn_oth_income_loss_fx_transaction_and_tax_translation_adj_q, 252), 252) / (ts_backfill(assets, 60) + 1000), industry) - 0.10 * group_rank(ts_delta(close, 5) / close, industry)
candidates.rationale: Industry-neutral 180-day rank of forward consensus dividend yield with universal accrual overlay and 5-day reversal overlay

hypotheses.title: Stabilized Domestic Operating Earnings Yield (fnd2_ebitdm) (fundamental)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Directly harvests domestic operating earnings power (fnd2_ebitdm), which previously demonstrated robust standalone alpha (Sharpe 1.62, Fitness 1.13 in candidate 4ffe00c2). Domestic operating earnings are insulated from foreign exchange volatility, geopolitical export tariffs, and international translation distortions. Combining domestic operating yield with the 30% balance-sheet accrual stabilizer and 10% price reversal overlay disciplines turnover to ~12%-13%, driving Fitness to >= 1.60 and Sharpe to >= 1.80 with low correlation.
confounders: Domestic economic recessions disproportionately affecting domestically focused firms
Cost-push inflation squeezing domestic margins faster than multinational exporters
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails if domestic earnings yield underperforms broad market earnings across multiple quarterly cycles.

hypotheses.title: Stabilized Forward Consensus Book-to-Price (anl4_bvps_median) (analyst4)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Directly enhances the consensus book-to-price frontier (anl4_bvps_median), which exhibited Sub-universe Sharpe 1.04 and zero self-correlation in Batch 163. Pairing the forward consensus book value yield with the 30% universal accrual stabilizer provides structural balance-sheet quality confirmation, eliminating value traps with deteriorating asset health. Turnover is compressed from 21% down to ~12%-13%, directly elevating Fitness to >= 1.55 with near-zero correlation to existing approved alphas.
confounders: Unforeseen asset impairments not yet recognized in analyst book estimates
Disruptive technology shifts eroding historical tangible asset values
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha underperforms if forward consensus book value fails to separate quality compounders from impaired balance sheets.
